class.name: VMLHotReloader
class.brief_description:
Polls watched content trees and forwards changes to [method VMLModLoader.reload_resources].
轮询受监视的内容目录，把变化转发给 [method VMLModLoader.reload_resources]。
class.description:
Created by [method VMLModLoader.start_hot_reload] (game) or the EditorPlugin (editor). Polls the base layer and every enabled mod's asset/data dirs every poll interval; changed files are passed to [method VMLModLoader.reload_resources].
由 [method VMLModLoader.start_hot_reload]（游戏）或 EditorPlugin（编辑器）创建。按轮询间隔检查基础层与所有已启用 mod 的 assets/data 目录；变化的文件传给 [method VMLModLoader.reload_resources]。

method.name: set_poll_interval
method.description:
Set the poll interval (clamped to >= 0.05s).
设置轮询间隔（下限 0.05 秒）。

method.name: rescan
method.description:
Re-seed the watcher from the current content roots.
用当前内容根目录重新初始化监视器。
